text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
We had a good race, but— what was that 
shining final spurt from Bright!? Could 
this be... the power of an Umamusume 
family?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
On top of that, next Mejiro Dober declared 
she'd surpass me as a member of the Mejiro 
family! No matter how many I push aside, 
new challengers just keep coming...!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
The power of the Umamusume family is way 
more dangerous than I thought! I need to 
uncover the essence of their strength 
before the next "Hanshin JF"!
